system.rule_handled: 33 messages handled by deterministic rules (transactional digests, receipts, automated notifications) — zero LLM tokens consumed
system.retrieval: thread-walk — every message walks its thread_id index chronologically; keyword cross-thread retrieval fallback via MailStore.search_keyword()
system.gate: approval with dry-run mode; irreversible sends blocked behind SafetyGate.execute_send(); outbox writes only on explicit human 'y'
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC co-founder on Legal mail (applied to m018) — extracted by LLM, persisted to prefs.json, survives process restart

capabilities.name: Triage
capabilities.claim: Assigns every inbox message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate). Rule-handled messages consume zero LLM tokens; the remainder are sent to the configured LLM in batches of 10.
capabilities.observable: Prints batch-by-batch progress and writes decisions.json. Rule-handled messages (transactional, receipts) appear with handled_by=rule; the rest show handled_by=model.

capabilities.name: Grounded Draft
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply only when the required facts exist in prior thread messages. If the thread contains no answerable context, the system drafts nothing — no canned 'I will look into it' text.
capabilities.observable: For each reply-dispositioned message: prints a grounded draft with cited message IDs, or '[R2] Information required to answer <id> was not found in inbox. Drafting nothing.' Cited IDs are verified to exist in the thread.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R2 with event_type=draft and cited field

capabilities.name: Safety Gate
capabilities.claim: All irreversible actions (send, delete) pass through SafetyGate before execution. In dry-run mode, zero files appear in outbox/. In live mode, each proposed send is displayed and requires explicit 'y' from the human.
capabilities.observable: Prints [GATE --dry-run] intercept notices for each proposed send. Reports suppressed count and confirms outbox_writes_count=0.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R3 with event_type=gate and status=dry_run; outbox/ directory contains zero new files

capabilities.name: Standing Instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects standing preferences in email bodies using the LLM (e.g. 'always CC X on legal mail'), persists them to prefs.json, and applies them on the next process run — after exit and restart.
capabilities.observable: Prints each extracted preference key (e.g. cc_legal_mail). Active preferences listed. prefs.json updated on disk. On the next run, outgoing drafts for matching senders include the CC address.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json, trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4 with event_type=preference_saved and preference_applied

capabilities.name: Hostile Inbox Defence
capabilities.claim: Detects prompt injections, credential phishing, domain spoofing, wire fraud, and privilege escalation in inbox messages. Refuses to act, logs a refusal naming the message id and what was attempted, and leaves the message in place.
capabilities.observable: Prints FLAGGED [<id>]: <attack_type> — <attempted_action> for each hostile message. Confirms zero outbox writes on its behalf.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R5 with event_type=refusal; no corresponding file in outbox/

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane dashboard (HTML + JSON) from a completed run: (1) Pending Actions with grounded drafts and gate status, (2) Flagged Threats refused and left in place, (3) Commitments extracted from the inbox as a calendar with multi-message derivation and surfaced schedule collisions.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html and dashboard.json. Pane 1 shows only genuine human-to-human pending replies (automated senders filtered, one entry per thread). Pane 3 surfaces the Sep 16 board deck deadline derived from two messages (m038 + m040) and the Sep 15 15:00 schedule collision.
capabilities.evidence: dashboard.html, dashboard.json, trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R6 with event_type=dashboard_generated

capabilities.name: Follow-up Tracker
capabilities.claim: Finds threads where Sam sent the last message and received no reply in 3+ days. For each such thread, drafts a short, grounded chase email using only facts from the thread history. m044 (Priya, sent Sep 2, unanswered) appears; m014 (already answered in-thread) does not.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {message_id, days_waiting, correspondent, draft}. Each draft is grounded in the thread; none are templated.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X1 with event_type=followup_chase_drafted and followup_scan_complete

capabilities.name: Thread Summarizer
capabilities.claim: For every thread with 3+ messages, walks the full conversation and uses the LLM to produce a one-sentence summary and the single open question or next action still pending. Collapses long threads to the essential question.
capabilities.observable: Prints a JSON list of {thread_id, message_count, summary, open_question, message_ids} for each qualifying thread. The staging-down thread and launch-week thread each appear with a distinct open question.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X2 with event_type=thread_summarised

capabilities.name: Smart Daily Digest
capabilities.claim: Agentic daily briefing with three sections: NEEDS YOU NOW, HAPPENED TODAY, CAN WAIT. Genuinely agentic: (1) uses LLM to plan which bucket each message belongs to, (2) persists digest_log.json so already-surfaced messages are skipped on the next run, (3) holds any irreversible action for human gate approval before acting.
capabilities.observable: Prints a structured digest to stdout and writes digest_output.json. Run it twice: the second run reports fewer new messages because digest_log.json persists seen IDs. Items in NEEDS YOU NOW show gate_status=AWAITING_APPROVAL.
capabilities.evidence: digest_output.json, digest_log.json (grows between runs), trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X3
